fields.description: DAMAC Islands is an inland Dubailand community of four- and five-bedroom townhouses and six- and seven-bedroom villas. Its original masterplan takes inspiration from six tropical destinations, arranging homes around lagoons and recreation spaces. It is separate from DAMAC Islands 2 and from Nakheel's Dubai Islands.

overview: The original brochure separates compact townhouse layouts from larger villa designs. Its four-bedroom townhouse has a ground-floor bedroom, rear garden and upper terrace. The seven-bedroom mansion drawing adds a basement with indoor parking and leisure rooms; these features should not be assumed for every home.
research.locationNote: DAMAC identifies the community as Dubailand. Its brochure map shows access in the Emirates Road and Al Qudra Road corridor. It is an inland lagoon development, not the coastal Dubai Islands in Deira; exact plot access should be confirmed.
research.priceNote: Both original documents start four-bedroom townhouses at AED 2.25m. The launch sheet lists five-bedroom homes at AED 3.07m and villa references of AED 6.31m, 13.57m and 18.61m; the brochure rounds or varies these to AED 3.1m, 6.3m, 13.55m and 18.5m. These are historical references, not current offers.
research.paymentNote: The original branded sheet shows 20% immediately, 55% across construction instalments and 25% on completion. Grouped monthly stages below preserve that schedule. Property Finder instead reports 20/ 40/ 40; obtain the exact cluster and unit contract rather than treating either as universal current terms.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder reports Q4 2028, but the reviewed original documents do not establish a universal completion quarter. Different clusters and releases require separate contractual confirmation.

facts.label: Original cluster themes
facts.value: Maldives, Bora Bora, Seychelles, Hawaii, Bali and Fiji are the six original brochure themes. They are not the eight themes of Islands 2.

facts.label: Area basis
facts.value: The brochure labels the figures total saleable area. They are not plot sizes or a guarantee of usable internal area, and other releases may use different layouts.
